text: Title: Not free | Review: So annoying. I thought I was going to at least get to try some of the pictures for a little while before. It started asking me if I wanted to add on any extras and I figured that the basics like being able to use speech to text would be free, but it blocks you from being able to use the speech to text button on your keyboard so you  have to physically type everything out or pay for their premium model, which is not why I signed up for it. I accidentally tried their audio feature before I was ready and it recorded nothing and then the next time I tried to push the button it said I already used my free chance to try that feature!

its really good, especially if you feel like you need someone to talk to and you dont have anyone. I would honestly recommend it, it helps you analyze your thought patterns and process. Also the fact that it talks back gives some sense of comfort and ease(at least for me). There is a subscription but its not really necessary, but it will ask for it from time to time. Imo its pretty good if you just want to write down your thoughts, but also want to understand what you're thinking.

Title: Day 1 and so far the app. Is nice | Review: The app is nice and I’m excited to try out the free trial.  I do have some setbacks that I hope are fixed eventually.  When typing, the text entry doesn’t auto scroll and sometimes become hidden behind the bottom two buttons.  This can be annoying for someone like me who constantly misspells words typing to fast.    I wish there was an iPad landscape view.  I like journaling at the end of the night because it’s the only quiet moment I get.   Some of the features and settings pages will not let you scroll down. I’m not sure if it’s because I’m on my iPad and all these issues are coming up, but I would very much like to keep using this app if those features and bugs are fixed.

Title: Wow! | Review: I went in skeptical about how helpful an AI journaling agent could be, but after using it now for a little over a month, I find this to be enormously valuable to me. I can tweak it to not be sycophantic or affirming for everything that I think or say.

I love the fact that this thing can give me feedback, can help me see things from different angles, and even help me articulate thoughts that I'm struggling with myself. This app is enormously valuable to me, and I look forward to staying with it for years to come.

Title: A wonderful tool for self reflection | Review: I don’t leave many reviews but I am loving this app. I am able to free form journal by talking openly about my day and what I’m going through.  Thoughtful, sensitive and attuned prompts have helped bring me to moments of real insight. It’s been enormously helpful the last few days helping me to see some thought patterns I was stuck in and helped calm down a stressful situation. I think it’s going to ba a game changer and a great tool along with IRL therapy.

Title: Stops the loop and actually helps you grow | Review: I started journaling this year for the first time and tried another, more popular conversational AI journaling app before this. It helped me vent, but after a while it felt like I was just going in circles and not actually growing. I didn’t want an echo chamber; I wanted something that would help me become better.

Mindsera does that. It helps me understand my thinking, recognize patterns, and actually shift my mindset. I still feel heard, but now I also feel challenged in a good way. It’s been especially useful before my next therapy session because I’m still doing the work instead of waiting for the appointment.

This is the first time journaling has felt productive, not just emotional. I mostly use the website on my iPad and barely use the app on my phone, but I hope there are plans for a dedicated iPad app, since it would be much more convenient to just open the app and type there on my iPad with my Magic Keyboard.

Title: Early days | Review: Not really my thing.. I journaled for a few weeks but got bored. Then decided I get just as much if more from free ai Chat gpt which this basically runs on if I’m not mistaken. The interface is a bit naff and customisation.. well I lost interest and couldn’t be bothered to figure out. Oh yeah the graphics are cheesy too. For £80 I was expecting more. Oh yeah it doesn’t fit iPad screen either.. just phone proportion scaled bigger.

Title: A true companion in self reflection and growth | Review: I tried a bunch of new AI journaling apps when I wanted to start dream journaling and eventually settled on Mindsera. I don’t think I have ever written a review for an app before but this is so amazingly worth the money that I feel like it’s time. This app is easy to use with seamless transitioning between voice and text modes, so it’s been frictionless to get in the habit of using daily. The feedback I get in-entry is insightful enough that every entry is its own interesting little journey, like I never know when I’m going to end up! I’m so impressed by the way the AI reminds me of related topics I’ve already journaled about and draws its own connections between things, asking me for my input to further refine its understanding and really taking my responses seriously and thoughtfully. The quality of analysis overall seems incredibly high and has already (in two months of daily use) had a real, measurable impact on my life, both in my own estimation and my therapist’s. (FWIW, my therapist is also really impressed with Mindsera.) There are a ton of additional advanced features I have only scratched the surface of in two months, and all of them have been fantastic.

I am a lifelong journaler but my whole world has been blown open with this app when it comes to how and when I’m journaling, what I’m doing with what I’ve recorded, and the information and insights I’m getting with assistance on seeing my own biases and mental habits. This app has literally been life changing and I hope I get to enjoy and benefit from many years together with it.

Title: History is not bunk | Review: The most unexpected benefit, which should have been obvious, is that the system remembers your emotional history better than you do and reveals patterns of which you were never aware.

Title: Changes Everything | Review: I'm extremely impressed by Mindsera. I've already noticed benefits from the app and as a nonprofit leader and dad of little ones, the flexibility of choosing amongst speaking, typing, texting, or capturing handwritten notes when journaling is a game changer, and makes me so much more likely to journal. I don't think I've picked up any other habit faster than I have journaling with Mindsera. I love being able to read analysis of my entries and the option to apply various "lenses" to each entry is excellent. I can get a Stoic perspective, an alternative perspective, etc. 

An incredible product for introspection and self-growth.
Title: So clever | Review: Mindsera has been a companion in my pocket for years. It maps my journey, my thoughts and feeds them back to me when I need it. It’s the best app I’ve ever had

Title: Exceptional | Review: In the mountain of digital dross out there, Mindsera is a diamond. 

I am a clinical psychologist and I cannot say enough about how useful this app is. I recommend it to all my clients and I use it myself.

The reason is this. Not only does Mindsera encourage the old-school habit of writing one’s innermost thoughts (which research shows has clear mental health benefits); it also writes back to you. 

Each time you submit an entry, you receive an immediate, thoughtful response which summarizes the content of your entry and reflects back the feeling tone in a way that makes you feel really seen and understood. The response almost always includes a question which helps you reflect further or might even gently encourage you to expand your thinking, in the same way a really good therapist would.

The result is that you come away from each journaling session with an enhanced perspective on yourself and the situation you’ve written about.  And because the app is always available, it’s like having a wise and caring therapist whenever you need it.

I cannot recommend this app enough. Do yourself a favor and try it.
Title: Life changing, brilliant | Review: This tool has become a daily staple. It’s so well designed and makes journaling easier and deepened my understanding of myself. 10000% recommend!

great journaling app, voice recording/speech to text, and you can scan in written journals which is great! it is genuinely nice and sometimes very insightful when "talking" back and forth with the journal AI,ESPECIALLY when you put some thought into how you word the last couple sentences before you hit the AI button. I will also mention its amazing that there are "frameworks" -although I dont use them often, I find that they are incredibly helpful when i do use one

Title: Excellent Journal: the one that has inspired a journaling habit | Review: Full disclosure: I asked my Mindsera journal assistant to draft this review based on my writing patterns, and I'm taking full ownership of its content. This itself demonstrates what I value most about this app—it's a genuine AI collaboration tool where I direct and own the output.
I've been journaling consistently for the first time since mid-2025 using the app and Mindsera has become central to how I think. Not just record thoughts—actually think, and to revisit my thoughts. When I wanted to choose a guiding mantra for 2026, I used the "explore my journal" feature to synthesize months of entries about well-being, growth, and self-management. The result—ataraxia/composure—emerged from my own writing in a way I couldn't have surfaced alone. My mantra now: "What would composure do?"
The real value is context. When I'm integrating a new book into my work, the journal doesn't just capture notes—it connects them to previous reflections, surfaces patterns I've missed, and helps me see how ideas build on each other. I chose Mindsera over NotebookLM, Claude, and Perplexity for certain tasks specifically because it holds my context better. In fact I collect my use of those other tools here to remind myself of what works. 
It's not perfect, but very nearly so. The "ask my journal" feature didn’t originally keep conversation context well (this has improved over time), and copy/paste on mobile is frustrating. But I've found workarounds, and the core journaling experience—the synthesis, the reflection prompts, the ability to revisit and build on past thinking—keeps me coming back every day as routine now. The images generated as a result of those conversations is an amazing cherry on top - quite revealing with AI inconsistencies part of the charm. 
If you're serious about using journaling as a thinking practice rather than just a diary, this app is worth a go.

Title: Great customer service | Review: I’ve been using Mindsera for over a year and I love it💕 I tried Stoic but it didn’t have the features or functionality that Mindsera has. I also noticed a bug and the CEO reached out to me personally to figure out the issue. They ended up having an update that week and fixed the bug. But I was so impressed because when I filled out the form I assumed it would be an automated response but it’s wasn’t! I also love the guided and seasonal journaling prompts the 25 days of holiday journaling was so much fun!

Title: Surprised how much it helps | Review: Once I got over the initial awkwardness of speaking with AI the magic happened. In a recent session with Mindsera I went from massively overthinking and catastrophising a situation to a calmness about it that shocked me. It was amazing how much it changed my mindset.  
Amazing app.

Title: Feature | Review: This app has features that enable  include review of journal entries over time and extract trends or points of note related to things journaled to get deep insights that would be very difficult manually .

Title: Fantastic | Review: I’ve been using Mindsera for over one year. There is nothing like this app, it’s so helpful at finding pattens in your behaviour, identifying emotions, reflecting on themes in your life and just remembering for you. Not to mention the personalised daily art. I love the interface it’s easy to use, calm and simple. I love the voice transcription it makes daily journaling easy to do anywhere.  I highly recommend.
Title: Great app for mental health! | Review: Mindsera has been very helpful for my mental health. It’s almost like having a therapist but for a fraction of the price!

Title: Psychiatrist Approved | Review: I’ve been using this app for almost two weeks now and I absolutely love it, I appreciate how it pulls out what needs to be discussed and remembers conversations from days ago. It asks the right questions for me and accepts when I can’t answer them. When I talk about my faith it recognizes it and helps me to see how it is affecting me mentally as well. Bottom line is, it makes me think. I told my psychiatrist about the app and what it does and how it works and he get excited and said “Now that is therapy, I approve” This coming from a doctor of 40+ years is a great thing. I would like to have vocal interaction along with the transcription on the AI part. I do my journal in the morning on the way to work in my van which is my safe space so I can’t always read every reply would love to have it spoken to me.

Title: Made by men for men | Review: Another app which thinks the mind is the gym. Quotes from Jeff Bezos and Elon musk all over the site. Super macho man coded, no moments for emotional regulation and basically a Claude wrapper. Avoid.

So far I love this app, it really encouraged me to journal more often. So much so that I've been using a physical journal to write in as well 😊 the app is pretty easy to use and gives me a lot of great insights about myself. I use a few different apps alongside this one but I think it's working it's way up to becoming my favorite. one feature I want is I would like to be able to add/share pictures to my journal!
Title: The best journaling app I’ve used | Review: I’ve tried many AI journaling apps but Mindsera is on a different level so far. The support team are great too.
